proposals.before: Traveled to Wei, with former Wu person Zhuang Ji Fuzi, Huaiyin Mei Sheng others associated.
proposals.after: Traveled to Liang, with former Wu person Zhuang Ji Fuzi, Huaiyin Mei Sheng others associated.
proposals.reason: Chinese 梁 denotes the Han kingdom of Liang here, not Wei; the idiomatic line already has Liang.

proposals.before: Sheng etc. envied Zou Yang, slandered him to Wei Xiao Wang.
proposals.after: Sheng etc. envied Zou Yang, slandered him to Liang Xiao Wang.
proposals.reason: 孝王 is King Xiao of Liang (梁孝王), not Wei; matches the idiomatic King Xiao of Liang.

proposals.before: Yue used Dafu Fan Li plans, captured strong Wu, hegemonized central states, yet finally executed person.
proposals.after: Yue used Dafu Zhong plans, captured strong Wu, hegemonized central states, yet finally executed person.
proposals.reason: Chinese 大夫種 is Grand Officer Zhong (Wen Zhong), not Fan Li; the idiomatic line already has Zhong.

proposals.before: Now consider the scholars of the realm who dwell in poverty and low estate. Though they may possess the arts of Yao and Shun, wield the eloquence of yiyin and Guan Zhong, and harbor the devotion of Long Pang and Bi Gan, wishing to devote their utmost loyalty to the ruler of their age—yet lacking anyone to introduce them or vouch for their worth—no matter how they exhaust their minds and seek to offer their faithfulness, the ruler will inevitably greet them with a hand on his sword and a suspicious glare. This is what prevents men of humble birth from gaining even the advantage of the gnarled log and the rotten stump.
proposals.after: Now consider the scholars of the realm who dwell in poverty and low estate. Though they may possess the arts of Yao and Shun, wield the eloquence of Yi Yin and Guan Zhong, and harbor the devotion of Long Pang and Bi Gan, wishing to devote their utmost loyalty to the ruler of their age—yet lacking anyone to introduce them or vouch for their worth—no matter how they exhaust their minds and seek to offer their faithfulness, the ruler will inevitably greet them with a hand on his sword and a suspicious glare. This is what prevents men of humble birth from gaining even the advantage of the gnarled log and the rotten stump.
proposals.reason: 伊 is Yi Yin; the lowercase fused romanization yiyin obscures the personal name.

proposals.before: Letter submitted Wei Xiao Wang, Xiao Wang sent people release him, finally became honored guest.
proposals.after: Letter submitted Liang Xiao Wang, Xiao Wang sent people release him, finally became honored guest.
proposals.reason: Chinese 梁孝王 is King Xiao of Liang (Liang), not Wei; the literal wrongly renders 梁 as Wei.

proposals.before: Thus, Qin trusted its attendants and perished, while Zhou employed a man who came like gathering crows and became king.
proposals.after: Thus, Qin trusted its attendants and was nearly killed, while Zhou employed a man who came like gathering crows and became king.
proposals.reason: Chinese 殺 here refers to the near-assassination of the Qin ruler in the Jing Ke episode, not that Qin actually perished; idiomatic already has 'nearly perished'.

decisions.reason: s0151’s 游於梁 names the Han kingdom of Liang, not Wei; the literal’s “Wei” invents a wrong polity, while “Liang” matches the Chinese and the idiomatic line.
s0153’s 惡之梁孝王 identifies King Xiao of Liang (梁孝王); rendering him as Wei Xiao Wang misnames the ruler and polity, and Liang Xiao Wang restores the source.
s0212’s 大夫種 is Grand Officer Zhong (Wen Zhong), not Fan Li; the literal wrongly substitutes Fan Li, and Dafu Zhong correctly follows the Chinese.
In 挾伊、管之辯, 伊 abbreviates 伊尹 (Yi Yin) paired with 管 (Guan Zhong); fused lowercase “yiyin” obscures the personal name, and “Yi Yin” restores standard naming without other change.
s0235’s 書奏梁孝王 is submission to King Xiao of Liang; “Wei Xiao Wang” mistranslates 梁 as Wei, and Liang Xiao Wang matches the Chinese and idiomatic.

Parallel 故秦信左右而殺 with the Jing Ke dagger episode in s0227 shows near-assassination of the Qin ruler, not Qin’s destruction; “perished” overstates 殺, and “was nearly killed” fits the context and idiomatic sense.
